name: Ink Bleed
description: The second clip spreads over the first like drops of ink in water, blooming from a few points with curling, wispy edges and a darker rim. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: tendrils
params.description: How far the curling tendrils reach out of the blooms

params.name: rim
params.description: How dark the rim of ink at the front of the blooms is

params.name: seed
params.description: Random seed for the drop positions and the swirls
